claim.statement: relish apply deploys or converges everything in the file, and relish delete removes the app while each node retires its instances on its own; re-applying a deleted app therefore converges to the file again.

sources.quote: deploy (or converge) everything in the file
remove the app from the cluster
Each node then retires its instances on its own

claim.measurable: Delete a running 2-service app and apply the same file again, either at once or after relish status shows no instances; every cycle reaches the desired running replica count and serves through every ingress within the pre-registered budget, with no stopped instances left behind.
